ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every direct shareholder, indirect shareholder, director, officer, and beneficial owner against the U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the Panamanian UAF (Unidad de Análisis Financiero) restricted and precautionary lists, and domestic judicial/administrative prohibition lists. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for Politically Exposed Persons under Law 23 of 2015 and FATF Recommendation 12, including source-of-wealth review for beneficial owners, directors, and agents. Ongoing monitoring must combine initial name-based screening at onboarding, refreshed screening at least every six months, and event-driven screening upon any change of ownership, directors, or residential address.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Oficina de Personas Jurídicas / RPOnline (www.registropublico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate form is the Panamanian Sociedad Anónima (S.A.). The proposed name must be expressed in Roman characters and should contain the suffix 'S.A.' for the standard corporation. The official registration language is Spanish; foreign-language names are accepted only if accompanied by a clear Spanish transliteration or legal translation for indexing and disambiguation purposes. Chinese-character or other non-Latin script names require a notarized and translated transliteration before name clearance.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registro Público rejects the proposed name, the applicant or the authorized Resident Agent may file a written administrative reconsideration request (recurso de reconsideración) with the Director General of the Registro Público within five business days of the rejection. If the reconsideration is denied, an appeal (recurso de apelación) may be filed with the administrative hierarchy of the Registro Público within ten business days. A separate judicial challenge may be brought before the Third Chamber of the Supreme Court of Justice (Sala Tercera de la Corte Suprema de Justicia) against the final administrative resolution. A rejected name may be re-submitted with a variant, accent, abbreviation, or additional token so that it ceases to be confusingly similar to an existing name. Reservation extensions are available by re-filing the same name clearance request through RPOnline before the original 90-day window expires; the re-filing must be accompanied by proof of ongoing incorporation instructions and the applicable resubmission fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only if the virtual service is supplied by the licensed Panamanian Resident Agent or Registered Office Provider and includes a physical address capable of receiving official process and correspondence in Panama. For the target business vertical micro-drama production and global distribution through a streaming application, a virtual office will be accepted for the shell holding entity only when the company maintains no physical licensure for film production or financial activity in Panama and restricts local administrative exposure to statutory filing, board minutes, and IP-owning arrangements. If the entity later hires employees, renders services in Panama, or obtains distribution contracts requiring substantive local management, a physical leased office and locally resident administrators will be required to satisfy commercial substance and economic-presence tests under Panamanian law and tax doctrine.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% per annum) for an unlicensed, low-risk vertical-drama holding and IP-licensing vehicle with a compliant UBO file and resident-agent registered address. The probability increases to approximately 25–50% if the entity is selected for a random UAF or Registro Público compliance exam, if the beneficial owner appears on an enhanced-risk list, or if unexplained high-volume payment flows are detected in the streaming app's Stripe/Apple/Google settlement accounts.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (Panama General Corporation Law), as amended by Ley 5 de 2007 and Ley 43 de 2011 — Articles 1 and 4 (incorporation and minimum capital), Article 5 (contents of the constitutive deed), Article 10 (registered office), Articles 24-29 (board of directors) and Articles 38-45 (officers); resident agent requirement codified under Ley 6 de 2003; Aviso de Operación and tax registration under Ley 15 de 2007.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas y Comercio (Public Registry of Panama, Legal Entities and Commerce Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (Public Deed of Incorporation), or private Acto Constitutivo, presented for inscription in the Folio Mercantil as 'Inscripción de Persona Jurídica'.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Article 4 of Ley 32 de 1927 requires authorized share capital of at least US$10,000. There is no statutory paid-up capital requirement at incorporation, no minimum issued-share threshold, and no escrow or blocked-account deposit. Shares may be issued at par and left unpaid until called by board resolution. Non-resident individuals or entities may hold 100% of the shares; bearer shares are permitted but must be immobilized pursuant to Ley 5 de 2007.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME], S.A. I. The directors, being duly constituted with a quorum, unanimously resolve to accept the subscription of one hundred (100) ordinary registered shares of one United States Dollar (US$1.00) each, representing the issued share capital, and declare the same fully paid. II. The board adopts the address stated in the Articles of Incorporation as the statutory registered office and ratifies the appointment of [RESIDENT AGENT] as resident agent. III. The board appoints [NAME] as President, [NAME] as Secretary and [NAME] as Treasurer, each for a one-year term. IV. The President and Secretary, acting jointly, are hereby authorized to execute public deeds, open and operate bank accounts, and sign commercial distribution agreements. UNANIMOUSLY APPROVED on this ___ day of ____________, 20___.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability check and drafting of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sistema de Consulta en Línea (online name search) and the appointed Panamanian resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name availability search through the Public Registry's online consultation tool or request a Certificado de Nombre. The resident agent then drafts the Articles of Incorporation in Spanish, including the corporate name, purpose clause covering production, development, financing, licensing and global distribution of vertical micro-drama audiovisual content, streaming-app operations and technology services, registered office address, US$10,000 authorized capital, share classes, and the initial director and resident agent designations.
required_dossiers: Name search receipt or Certificado de Nombre
Draft Articles of Incorporation (Estatutos)
Passport or ID copies of initial directors and incorporators
Resident agent acceptance letter (Designación de Agente Residente)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, obtain a new name certificate and amend the draft articles before notarization. If the registry issues a note on the purpose clause, revise the purpose language and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the incorporation instrument (Escritura Pública)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario Público de la República de Panamá (Panama City notary public)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the public deed of incorporation before a Panamanian notary. The incorporators appear personally or by an attorney-in-fact, and the resident agent confirms acceptance. The notary reviews the articles, witnesses signature, and issues certified first copies (copia certificada) for registry submission. If no deed is desired, the private Acto Constitutivo may be executed and subsequently legalized for presentation to the Registry.
required_dossiers: Passport or ID of each incorporator
Final draft Articles of Incorporation
Resident agent appointment and acceptance
Payment receipts for stamp tax and notary fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any notarial omissions via an aclaratoria deed or a new protocolized instrument. If a witness or incorporator is unavailable, execute a power-of-attorney ratification before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription with the Public Registry of Panama (statutory incorporation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas y Comercio, Folio Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the certified first copy of the Escritura Pública (or legalized Acto Constitutivo) with the Public Registry, together with the completed registry request form and the tariff payment made to the Tesoro Nacional. The Registry reviews the instrument for formal legal compliance and, upon approval, inscribes the company in the Folio Mercantil, returning an inscribed copy and a certificate of inscription with the assigned folio number.
required_dossiers: Certified first copy of the notarized Escritura Pública
Registry application request form
Proof of payment of the registry inscription tariff
Power of attorney if filing by representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a 'nota defectuosa' listing formal defects, correct the instrument through an aclaratoria deed or supply the missing exhibits, pay the resubmission fee, and re-present the dossier within the statutory cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of first board resolution and corporate governance formalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Panamanian resident agent (internal corporate governance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first meeting of the board of directors, evidence the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution covering share subscription, the statutory registered office, resident agent ratification, and appointment of officers (President, Secretary, Treasurer). Execute share certificates for the subscribed shares, open the corporate ledger books (Libro de Registro de Acciones and Libro de Actas), and adopt the corporate seal.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma first board resolution
Share subscription and payment statement
Share certificates for issued shares
Corporate ledger books and seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any quorum or subscription defect is identified, convene an extraordinary board meeting to ratify the acts; if a director fails to sign, obtain written unanimous consent in lieu of meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — RUC and Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — e-Tax 2.0 portal (SIE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty calendar days of incorporation, file the Aviso de Operación under Ley 15 de 2007 and apply online for the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC). Declare the company's Panama-source taxable scope under the territorial tax regime and provide the registered office address. The DGI will issue the RUC certificate and the corporate tax ID for subsequent invoicing and bank onboarding.
required_dossiers: Certificate of inscription from the Public Registry
Aviso de Operación form (Form 800-845 series)
RUC registration form
Certified copy of the Articles of Incorporation
Resident agent confirmation and registered address
Identification of legal representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify inconsistencies signaled by the DGI through amended filing in e-Tax 2.0; if the Aviso de Operación is filed late, pay the corresponding fine (multa) under Ley 15 de 2007 and submit the missing documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal business license (Aviso de Operación Municipal and Patente Comercial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía del Municipio de Panamá — Dirección de Rentas Municipales (or the municipality of the registered operational office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the municipal Aviso de Operación form for the activity category 'servicios de producción y distribución de contenido audiovisual y comercio electrónico', pay the municipal patent fee based on expected gross receipts or the fixed municipal tariff, and obtain the annual Patente Comercial and municipal registration certificate. Renew the patent annually.
required_dossiers: DGI RUC certificate
Certificate of incorporation from Public Registry
Lease agreement or proof of registered office address
Certificado de uso de suelo (zoning clearance) from the municipality
Fire safety approval for the premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If zoning clearance is denied because the address is residential, request a change-of-use statement or relocate the office to a commercially zoned property, then amend the registered address with the Public Registry and DGI before refiling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Category I environmental registration (Registro Ambiental) with MiAMBIENTE
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección Nacional de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Given the non-industrial digital media and office-based activity, apply for a Category I environmental registration (Certificado de Registro Ambiental) under Decreto Ejecutivo 123 de 2009. Submit the standard registration form through the SIGAP environmental process, confirming that operations generate office-grade sanitary effluent, no point-source combustion emissions, and routine solid and electronic waste streams. The certificate must be maintained and displayed.
required_dossiers: Category I environmental registration application form
Certificate of incorporation and RUC
Lease agreement or proof of premises
Description of the audiovisual production and streaming activity
Solid waste management commitment and e-waste disposal plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MiAMBIENTE reclassifies the project as Category II, prepare a preliminary environmental assessment (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental Categoría II) through an environmental technician registered with MiAMBIENTE and resubmit for approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire safety approval and occupational health and safety clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (BCBRP) — Dirección Técnica de Seguridad contra Incendios; Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the premises floor plan and fire-load calculation to the BCBRP for plan review, then undergo the physical inspection verifying extinguishers, emergency exits, evacuation routes, emergency lighting and signage. Obtain the fire safety certificate. Concurrently, register the workplace health and safety program with MITRADEL under Ley 44 de 2010 and Decreto Ejecutivo 100 de 2018 and obtain the workplace clearance certificate.
required_dossiers: Fire safety inspection application form
Building floor plan and fire-load calculation
Lease deed or title of premises
Certificate of inspection of fire extinguishers and equipment
Occupational health and safety program (MITRADEL)
Appointment of safety delegate if workforce exceeds ten employees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Remediate violations documented in the BCBRP inspection act, submit photographic evidence of corrective actions, and request re-inspection within fifteen days. For MITRADEL, correct the program filing and resubmit through the designated digital platform.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) — official portal www.dgi.gob.pa, operating the e-Tax 2.0 / SITIO platform for RUC issuance, filings, and electronic invoicing; complementary registration with the Registro Público de Panamá (corporate existence and resident agent) and the Municipalidad de Panamá (Aviso de Operación).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: incorporate the S.A. in the Registro Público via a licensed resident agent (no minimum capital). Step 2: appoint the resident agent or a local director to hold the power of attorney and file the RUC application (DGI Form 001 online in e-Tax 2.0/SITIO), attaching notarized public deed, proof of local address, passport copies of shareholders and the beneficial-ownership declaration (Ley 254/2021). Step 3: obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) as the single TIN for ISR and ITBMS. Step 4: obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación; register with CSS only if hiring local employees. Step 5: for export/streaming operations, activate the ANA-SIGA customs exporter profile and, if required, the SEM license (Law 41/2007). Normal DGI turnaround 5-15 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope — the S.A. is taxed at entity level only on Panama-source income (25% standard corporate ISR); foreign-source income from global micro-drama production and distribution is outside the Panamanian tax base. The S.A. is not a pass-through; dividends paid to non-resident shareholders trigger 10% withholding, and remittances of royalties/technical fees to non-residents are subject to 12.5% withholding unless exempted by a specific regime or treaty.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists in the Republic of Panama. The US dollar (USD) circulates as full legal tender pursuant to Law 84 of 1904, and the Panamanian Balboa (PAB) exists solely as an accounting unit at a 1:1 parity without circulating banknotes. Monetary supervision is performed indirectly: prudential regulation of banks and financial institutions is vested in the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP); the Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as the fiscal agent of the State; the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) manages public finances; and the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) executes AML/CFT financial intelligence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full and unrestricted convertibility on both current account and capital account. Because the economy is fully dollarized, there are no exchange controls, no transactions licensed by a central monetary authority, no import/export currency authorization, and no profit-remittance restrictions. Dividends, intercompany loans, royalty payments, capital repatriation, and liquidation proceeds may be transferred abroad without SBP or MEF approval. The sole practical frictions are AML/CFT reporting thresholds (cash transactions at or above USD 10,000 are reportable to the UAF; international fund transfers of USD 50,000 or more are included in UAF surveillance) and correspondent-bank due diligence imposed by US clearing banks under OFAC sanctions screening. A foreign shareholder's dividend remittance from a Panamanian S.A. is subject to Panamanian dividend withholding tax: 5% on distributions of already-taxed Panamanian-source profits and 10% on distributions of untaxed foreign-source profits, under the territorial income tax regime reformed by Law 57 of 2023.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. Income generated by the export of digital micro-drama content (app-store sales, licensing, subscription streaming, and ad-supported revenue) may be collected in USD, retained offshore or onshore indefinitely, and redeployed without surrender, conversion, or central bank approval. The applicable obligation is purely documentary: the exporter must correctly identify the foreign-source or Panamanian-source character of each revenue stream for the 5%/10% dividend distinction and for the Law 57 of 2023 economic-nexus (nexo económico) sourcing rules, and must retain underlying contracts and settlement records for banking and tax file reviews.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High as a supplementary settlement rail; Low as the primary treasury host. Selected global fintech EMIs (for example Payoneer, Dukascopy, or Multitude/LeaBank) can supply multi-currency wallet accounts and low-cost MT103/SEPA payment execution; however, none holds a Panamanian banking license and none may lawfully take deposits from the Panamanian public under Ley 23 de 2015 and the SBP money-remittance licensing regime. An unlicensed EMI cannot offer Panamanian regulatory protection, deposit insurance, or access to the SBP complaint and freeze-remedy framework. Recommended structure for the micro-drama group: the Panama S.A. owns a US Delaware or Hong Kong merchant-of-record subsidiary that contracts Apple App Store Connect, Google Play Console, and any Stripe-based flows; the subsidiary collects app-store receivables and then repatriates funds to Panama by intercompany dividend or trademark/license royalty via SWIFT MT103. Stripe has no Panama-domiciled merchant onboarding, so the foreign merchant-of-record layer is mandatory for Stripe rail coverage.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: SBP customer due diligence rules allow a risk-based approach where non-face-to-face identification is acceptable for low-risk corporate clients, typically using biometric verification and certified electronic signatures. In practice, Tier-1 Panamanian banks (Banco General, Banistmo, BAC) usually accept a live video interview for a foreign-owned S.A., but the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) or a director must be prepared to appear in a video call with the compliance officer and to provide notarized, apostilled, or legalized corporate documents. A physical visit to Panama City is not statutorily mandatory, but it materially shortens onboarding, reducing it to roughly two to four weeks with a visit versus six to ten weeks fully remote. The bank will additionally require the licensed Panamanian resident agent (abogado) to certify the corporate minute books and to evidence the board resolution authorizing account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque equity structure: bearer shares not immobilized, UBO not declared, or ownership concealed through a private interest foundation (PIF) layer.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Exchange all bearer shares into registered form and deposit any remaining bearer certificates with an authorized custodian under the bearer-share custody regime (Ley 47 de 2013); file the annual beneficial-owner declaration with the Registro Público under Ley 70 de 2019; produce the S.A. incorporation deed, share ledger, and certificate of good standing; present certified passports, residence proof, and a personal source-of-wealth statement for every UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No economic nexus: the S.A. has no local payroll, no leased office, and books only intangible licensing, which under Law 57 of 2023 may be re-characterized as domiciliation-only and treated as a conduit.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide executed content-distribution agreements with Apple and Google, ad-network publisher contracts, producer agreements for ISIC 5911 vertical micro-dramas, a 12-24 month production pipeline, hosting and infrastructure contracts (AWS or Google Cloud), a substance memorandum identifying the country of creative control, and a multi-market revenue forecast dashboard.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Freshly incorporated entity with rapid capital injection: USD 500,000 or more credited in the first 90 days from a privately held foreign company or from a high-risk jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sworn capital-subscription declaration (declaración de aporte de capital), notarized shareholder resolution, bank reference letters dated less than 90 days, shareholder tax returns or audited financial statements, CRS/FATCA self-certifications, and a sources-of-funds breakdown evidencing no linkage to OFAC, EU, or UN sanctioned persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border traffic mismatch: app-store collections are credited in the US or Hong Kong merchant-of-record subsidiary while treasury consolidation occurs in Panama, which banks may flag as a conduit pattern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant-of-record agreements, intercompany license and service agreements, transfer-pricing dossier or simplified comparability analysis, intercompany ledger, quarterly reconciliation of app-store settlements, audited consolidation, and a treasury policy memorandum describing the settlement architecture to the relationship manager.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk end-user geography: in-app sales originating from sanctioned or embargoed app-store regions, or advertising traffic derived from high-risk sources.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Geo-blocking and app-store regional availability configuration, compliance policy prohibiting distribution where sanctioned, ad-traffic KYC and anti-ad-fraud controls, evidence of UAF suspicious-transaction reporting, and CDD files of all advertising and ad-network partners.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Wire protocol: SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire for the US domestic leg) from the shareholder's bank to the S.A.'s Panama USD account through New York clearing correspondents (typically Citibank, JPMorgan Chase, or Bank of America). The remittance information field should state CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION or SHARE SUBSCRIPTION, and the ordering customer field must identify the exact UBO remitter. Because Panama is dollarized, no currency conversion and no central bank authorization are required; the SBP-licensed receiving bank applies standard KYC, UAF monitoring for transfers at or above USD 50,000, and cash reporting at or above USD 10,000. Supporting documents: shareholder resolution authorizing the capital increase, notarized amendment of registered capital, sworn attribution of the contribution, and the bank's corporate KYC pack. The dossier must be retained for at least five years.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for production licensing fees, cross-border crew payroll, supplier invoices, and FX-converted payments to vendors in EUR, GBP, INR, BRL, or MXN; (2) commercial documentary credits under UCP 600 and standby letters of credit where a vendor demands bank risk intermediation for larger physical purchases such as studio equipment or co-production logistics; (3) domestic Panama ACH clearing (ACH Panama through the national clearing house) and high-value USD wire via Fedwire or CHIPS for local and US-domiciled post-production, legal, and ad-tech vendors; (4) Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console proceeds first credit the foreign merchant-of-record subsidiary, then enter Panama by MT103 as intercompany dividend or royalty. No SBP exchange authorization applies to any outbound transfer; the bank applies OFAC/UN sanctions screening and may request underlying commercial invoices for transfers exceeding USD 100,000. Stripe does not support Panama-domiciled merchant accounts, so Stripe settlements must be incurred in the foreign subsidiary and repatriated intercompany.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable FX forwards (USD against EUR, GBP, JPY, MXN, CAD, and CHF) with SBP-licensed banks; maturities typically one to twelve months; no exchange-control permit required.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on restricted or non-deliverable currencies (offshore CNY/CNH, ARS, NGN, KRW, IDR, EGP) booked through international bank branches in Panama; settlement is a net USD difference referenced to central-bank or industry reference rates.

Cross-currency swaps (USD vs EUR, USD vs GBP, USD vs JPY) under the ISDA 2002 Master Agreement and Credit Support Annex for converting long-term intercompany license receivables or bond-style proceeds; requires a board-approved derivative policy and credit arrangements with the counterparty bank.

Plain-vanilla FX options (calls and puts) for protecting large quarterly app-store and ad-network remittances; permissible as OTC derivatives when the hedge objective is documented in the treasury policy and aligned with IFRS 9 hedge accounting designations.

Currency-linked swaps are permissible in Panama, but a Balboa (PAB) swap leg is structurally unavailable because the Balboa is only an accounting unit at a 1:1 parity with the US dollar; any local-currency hedging requirement must therefore be executed directly in USD.

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: only Panama-source income is subject to CIT; foreign-source revenue of the micro-drama streaming S.A. (e.g., App Store sales to non-Panama users) is excluded from the taxable base. Available incentives: Law 49/2013 film-production cash rebates (15–25% of qualified local production spend); Multinational Corporate HQ (SEM) regime 0–5% income rates for qualified licensees; no patent-box regime for digital content.
